scope.claim: Bind declared reference and known visual gaps; not a proof of AI image comprehension or universal aesthetic quality.

findings.originalReference: Adopted B1 already contains lower-left writer; old HTML proposal was insufficient primary authority.
findings.continuity: NEXT had a LIVE design-document pointer but no frozen selected-image binding; existing instructions did not enforce the selected original in comparison.
findings.classification: Known omitted effect was incorrectly softened to user-preference pending; writer remains NEEDS_WORK.

adoptedMethods.principle: Preserve actual visual authority and inspect rendered output, not detector approval.
Match completion claims to relevant evidence; functional counts do not certify material.

changes: Existing inspector exposes selected source/actual-expected hash/region.
Existing preparation/comparator enforce active NEXT frozen source and region plus authority hash.
Selected original is attached to every native image report; secondary proposals cannot hide it.
Known missing implementation cannot become unverified preference or pass; current PNG evidence is required for passed claims and decoded by the existing comparator.
Existing viewer now opens original B1 writer region first; product writer styling unchanged.

checks.nativeProductSuite: NOT_RERUN: product runtime and native fixtures unchanged; earlier151/151 is historical function evidence, not material acceptance.
checks.publisher: Exact staged-tree validation/transport/CI recorded separately by checkpoint tool.

cost.perComparison: A few local reads/hashes plus existing image comparison; no network/model/daemon.
cost.unitCost: Nine tests about0.31 seconds in the observed run; not a performance guarantee.

limits: Checks validate evidence identity and declared omissions; truthful source/render inspection remains required.
No new cold-reader model test or claim that every visual mistake is detected.
Writer material is still NEEDS_WORK; next is original-reference repair, then popup interiors.
Formal broad proof/acceptance/header promotion and actual device/account qualification remain separate.
